name: Concrete
description: The feeling of buttoning your coat before stepping outside. Fresh, structured, decided.

name: Bois Impérial by Essential Parfums
description: Smells grounding and calm, like the person who never raises their voice. You'd follow them out of any room.

name: Cedrus by Chloé
description: The person who doesn't check their phone during dinner, laying back on a warm leather chair. Grounded, calm, deliberate. People across the room notice this scent.

name: Cuir 1976 by Jean Paul Gaultier
description: Like a moment when you drink a warm espresso and looking for something inside a well-worn leather bag. Dark, rich, slightly sweet.

name: Cuir Intense by Guerlain
description: The last person to sit down at the table. Like the weight of a good leather bag set on the chair next to yours — heavy, warm, expensive.

name: Dreams and Nightmares by L'Epoque Parfums
description: The pause before you say something that changes the conversation. Like the air right before a thunderstorm — wet earth, cold wind, something electric. Only the people closest to you sense it.

name: Escentric 05
description: Fresh and focused like your new business venture.

name: Legend
description: Doesn't surprise you. Doesn't need to. Shows up, delivers, leaves.

name: Megamare by Orto Parisi
description: Saying no when you need to. Bold, relentless, zero apology. This scent walks into the room before you do.

name: Mistpouffer by Stora Skuggan
description: Deleting the email instead of replying. Like blowing out a match — brief smoke, dry wood, then nothing. Clean, deliberate, final.

name: Musky Oakmoss
description: Not there yet, but knows exactly what they want and is going for it.

name: Penguin by Zoologist
description: The cold focus of a 6am workout when no one else is up yet. Like the first breath of freezing air that hits your lungs. Clear, sharp, wide awake. Fills the space around you.

name: Sailing Day by Maison Margiela
description: Hanging up the phone after closing a big deal. Walking out into the rain and smelling wet streets and charged air. The city smells different when you've won.

name: Sel d'Argent by BDK Parfums
description: Cold water splashed on your face before a big day. Clean, sharp, mineral. This scent stays close to your skin.

name: This is Not A Blue Bottle 1.5 by Histoires de Parfums
description: Your desk at the end of a productive day — everything cleared, screen off, cool air. Mineral, clean, a touch of sweetness. Nothing left to decide.

name: Dirty Rice by BORNTOSTANDOUT
description: Remember you as a kid drinking warm milk with cookies. Soft, creamy, a little earthy underneath. Very intimate and nostalgic.

name: Ani by Nishane
description: A warm kitchen full of people on a holiday morning. Sweet, spicy, generous. The kind of scent that makes a whole room feel like home. Everyone gravitates toward it.

name: Baby Powder
description: Unfamiliar at first. Then suddenly the only thing that feels right.

name: Beige by Chanel
description: Soft, floral, slightly sweet — like getting dressed up for brunch with your favourite people and sharing a croissant with honey. Scent stays very close to skin.

name: Blanc Sada by L'Entropiste
description: Remember the moments when you look put together without trying? Thats how it smells, relaxed and elegant. People near you will feel comforted by this scent.

name: By the Fireplace
description: Nowhere to be. No one to perform for. Just be.

name: Eau Duelle
description: It smells like being welcomed.

name: En Passant by Frederic Malle
description: When you are walking past a blooming bush on a May morning and stopping to smell something fresh, powdery, a little green like spring landed on your skin.

name: Gentle Fluidity Gold by Francis Kurkdjian
description: A long hug from someone wearing a cashmere sweater. Warm, soft, slightly spicy, enveloping. The scent equivalent of being wrapped up and not wanting to go anywhere.

name: Green Vanille by Régime des Fleur
description: Vanilla ice cream with fresh herbs on top — sounds strange, tastes perfect. Creamy, green, a little nutty. Sweet but interesting. Not what you'd expect.

name: Gris Charnel by BDK
description: A warm cardigan that still smells like someone you love. Soft, slightly sweet, a little spicy. Only those close to you will notice.

name: Musc Outreblanc by Guerlain
description: Smells like your skin after a long warm bath. Soft, powdery, barely there. So close it's almost invisible — only someone hugging you would catch it.

name: Rain Tea by Chasing Scents
description: A rainy afternoon with the windows cracked open, like a cup of camomile tea. The kind of calm you can actually smell. Gentle enough that only people near you will notice.

name: Totally White 126 by Parle Moi de Parfum
description: The first warm day in spring after cold winter when all the flowers open at once. Bright, soft, sweet but not heavy. Like walking through a park and breathing deeper with a smile on face.

name: Un Bois Vanille by Serge Lutens
description: A warm chocolate shop in winter. Rich, dark vanilla with something woody underneath. Not candy, but more like the expensive kind you unwrap slowly. Very close to skin.

name: You Doux
description: Smells like someone who remembered how you take your coffee.

name: Dirty Hinoki
description: A wooden cabin you just arrived at for vacation. Everything smells new and clean — fresh wood, cool air, a little citrus from the kitchen. Grounding.

name: Ambre Chromatique by Maison Crivelli
description: A meditation retreat on a cold morning. Still air, smoke from something burning far away, wood underneath. Like the air itself is asking you to slow down. Private, intentional, yours alone.

name: Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert by Bulgari
description: The first five minutes inside a luxury hotel. Cool marble, fresh flowers at reception, everything spotless. You can't name what smells so good — it just does.

name: Heliodose by Marlou
description: Stepping out of a hot bath into cool air. Clean skin, a little steam, nothing else. Barely there, stays close to skin.

name: Hinoki & Cedarwood by Jo Malone London
description: A brand new wooden house that still smells like the forest it came from. Clean, dry, aromatic. The scent that actually fills the room.

name: L'Eau Papier by Diptyque
description: Like opening a brand new notebook. The feeling of the morning before you've made any plans. This scent is very close to skin.

name: L'Ombre Des Merveilles by Hermès
description: Coming home to an apartment where someone burned a nice candle earlier. Warm, sweet, smoky — the smell is still there, hanging in the air like a welcome.

name: Naked Dance by .Oddity
description: Walking past a flower market and catching something like fresh flowers, earth, warm stone. You smell it from across the street.

name: New Zealand
description: Far enough from everything to finally hear yourself.

name: Osmanthe Yunnan by Hermès
description: Biting into a perfectly ripe peach over the kitchen sink. Juicy, sweet but not sugary, a little floral. Simple in the best way.

name: Series 3 Incense: Kyoto by Comme des Garcons
description: The quiet after you blow out a candle. Warm smoke hanging in the air, dry wood, stillness. Not a perfume but a pause. People nearby will sense it.

name: Shiso
description: Clean like rain on stone.

name: Tam Dao by Diptyque
description: Smooth, creamy, a hint of spice. You put it on and feel more put-together instantly. Like coming out of a yoga studio with real wood floors. Everything feels considered.

name: Tokyo
description: Every note in its place. Nothing added. Nothing missing.

name: Yawahada (Soft Skin) by J-Scent
description: Freshly ironed pillowcases. Warm, smooth, a hint of something powdery and sweet. Nobody else smells it — it's just for you.

name: Coven
description: Hiking through a forest after a storm. Wet bark, moss, fallen branches, earth kicked up by your boots. Raw, real, and everyone around you knows you've been outside.

name: Accord No. 10 by RAER Scents
description: A tropical garden right after heavy rain. Green, alive, electric. Like someone opened all the windows in a house surrounded by plants. Fresh but warm.

name: Anima Mineralis by DeGrhaal
description: A thunderstorm in the mountains. Wet rock, lightning in the air, something animal. Wild, unapologetic, fills every room you walk into.

name: Baikal Leather
description: Cold enough to feel alive. Remote enough to feel free.

name: Coyoacán by Fantôme
description: An evening walk through dry hills as the sun goes down. Warm sage, dried wildflowers, dusty trail. Something sweet blooming somewhere you can't see. Warm, smoky, a little mysterious.

name: Falling Trees by Régime des Fleurs
description: Sitting by a campfire in a pine forest. Resin, smoke, cracked branches. The smell that stays on your jacket the next morning. Close to skin.

name: From the Garden
description: Dirt under the nails. Sun on the neck. Nowhere else to be.

name: Gothic by Brera6 Perfumes
description: A cave entrance on a cold morning. Damp stone, old resin dripping from the trees above, air that hasn't moved in a long time. Deep, dark, stays close to skin.

name: Montecristo by Masque Milano
description: Deep in the forest where the light barely reaches. Dark wood, damp leaves, something smoky like a distant fire. Thick, intense, private scent.

name: Morel Map by Clue Perfumery
description: Kneeling in the forest picking mushrooms after rain. Wet soil between your fingers, crushed leaves, the smell of something alive under the ground. Nobody smells it but you.

name: Polish Potatoes by Bohoboco
description: A countryside you've never been to but somehow recognize. Lying in tall grass on a warm day — wildflowers, dry earth, the sun baking everything around you. Sweet and raw, like you rolled in a meadow.

name: Salt by Scent Trunk
description: Sea air on a rocky beach when nobody else is around. Salt on your skin, a little smoke, cold wind. Scent is close to skin.

name: Sándalo by Tanaïs
description: Walking across a volcanic field — hot black rock, dry mineral air, cracked earth. Nothing grows here but it smells alive. Powerful, raw, impossible to miss.

name: Sandflowers
description: Wind, salt, nothing on the calendar. Finally.

name: The Lobster by Moth and Rabbit
description: A cold river in the woods. Wet stones, green leaves, cold water on your hands. Wild but clean — like nature without any filter. People around you will notice.

name: I Am Verdant by Vyrao
description: You walking into a plant shop on a sunny morning. Not sharp, not heavy, just energizing. Like the outdoors came inside.

name: Aromatics Elixir
description: From an era when excess was a philosophy. You understand why.

name: Encre Noire
description: Dark, deliberate, and completely unbothered by your reaction to it.

name: Feminité du Bois by Serge Lutens
description: The kind of perfume that feels grown-up in a good way. Warm, slightly spicy, a little sweet. A scent that stays in the air after you walk through.

name: Fireside Story by For Strange Women
description: The smell that stays on your sweater after sitting by a bonfire. Woodsmoke, dry branches, something slightly sweet underneath. Only you know it's there.

name: Grey Flannel
description: Smells like staying in when everyone else went out.

name: Gris Clair
description: Introverted. Mysterious. Entirely your own.

name: L'Etoile Mourante by Sylhouette Parfums
description: A lit match that just went out, the smell of a leather journal, a hint of pepper. Like the last hour of a dinner party when the candles are low. Very intimate.

name: Lost Alice by Masque Milano
description: Like someone just made you a warm drink with milk, honey, and a handful of fresh flowers on the table. Sweet, gentle, personal. You'd have to be close to catch this smell.

name: Mixed Emotions by Byredo
description: A cup of strong black tea with berries, and something woody underneath, a little bitter, a little sweet. Comforting but not simple. People around you will notice this scent.

name: Notturno by Meo Fusciuni
description: Like sitting in a leather armchair reading late at night with a drink in your hand and a stick of incense burning low. Scent stays close to you..

name: Radio Bombay by DS&Durga
description: The kind of scent that makes people lean in and ask what you're wearing. Easy, natural, like sun-warmed skin after a day outside. To try on skin!

name: Reclaimed by Redwood Alchemy
description: Morning walk through a forest after rain. Wet leaves, green moss, the smell of wood drying in the sun. Calm, grounding, like nature taking its time.

name: Romance Noire by Sylhouette Parfums
description: A glass of red wine in a comfy leather chair. Elegant and warm, not harsh. The people closest to you will notice this scent.

name: Sage's Rose by TSU LANGE YOR
description: Roses but not from a florist — more like dried petals in a wooden box with incense nearby. Warm, earthy, a little smoky. Not a synthetic rose — a real one.

name: Vanilla Vellichor Providence Perfume Co.
description: A cozy used bookshop on a rainy afternoon. Warm vanilla, old paper, a hint of nutmeg. The kind of smell that makes you want to stay and read for hours. Barely leaves your skin.

name: SALA by TSU LANGE YOR
description: Like cracking black pepper over a salad with a lot of greens and berries. Cool, fresh, a bit spicy, with light sweetness to it.

name: Aire Sutileza Elixir by Loewe
description: Sweet like ripe fruit, not like candy. Stays close — you smell it on your wrist, not across the room.

name: Avgoustos
description: Heat, salt, time slowing down on purpose.

name: Bois de Yuzu
description: Smells like the night is still young.

name: Cedrat Tonic by Les Liquides Imaginaires
description: Like standing near a river with wild herbs growing on the bank. Green, fresh, a bit like rosemary but softer. You barely notice it's there — in a good way.

name: Chloë Sevigny Little Flower by Régime des Fleurs
description: Berries and roses, but there's something smoky underneath like a candle was just blown out nearby. Sweet but not innocent.

name: Delulu by .Oddity
description: Roses and apricot jam, but not delicate — there's a thickness to it, almost like warm skin. Sweet and weird at the same time.

name: Inlé by Memo Paris
description: A cup of sweet tea with fig and cardamom. Warm and generous. People around you will notice and they'll like it.

name: Luster by Alloy Studio
description: Warm pie crust cooling on the counter. Brown sugar melting into butter.

name: Nº4 Neon by Thomas Kosmala
description: Like someone squeezed grapefruit and melon into the air right after a summer rainstorm. That electric freshness reaches out to everyone in the room.

name: One Umbrella for Two by Floraïku
description: Like opening a box of berry pastries. Sweet and comforting, like a snack you'd eat curled up at home. More like the smell left on a scarf than a perfume you spray.

name: Rose Atlantic by DS&Durga
description: Flowers left on a beach towel. Salt air through an open window at dawn.

name: Solo Vulcan
description: Smells like momentum. The kind that doesn't need a plan.

name: Thai Lychee by History Parfums
description: Fresh lychee and peach. Tropical, juicy, unapologetically sweet. Like walking through a fruit market somewhere warm.

name: Un jardin sur le nil
description: Moves like you do. Light, unhurried, and somehow everywhere at once.

name: You Or Someone Like You by Etat Libre d'Orange
description: Cold lemonade in a sun-warmed garden. Mint leaves crushed between your fingers.

name: Black Tea
description: Chinnamon cookies with black tea - like Christmas in a warm kitchen. Nostalgic. Stays close but people nearby will notice this scent.
Knows exactly where to cross the line. That's what makes it safe to be around.

name: 204 Velvet Fig by Bon Parfumeur
description: Lying in the grass at a park on a Saturday with your eyes closed and the sun on your face. Sweet, warm, nowhere to be. People next to you feel the scent.
Smells like someone who already thought of everything so you don't have to.

name: Bibliothèque by Byredo
description: A rainy Sunday when you cancel everything and stay on the couch. Warm drink, a candle, a book you've been meaning to start. The whole apartment smells like this.

name: Cannabis Patchouli by Dries Van Noten
description: A friend's apartment where they always burn herbs and the windows are open. Warm wood floors, a blanket on the couch, tea already made. People across the room will catch this scent

name: Chocolate Greedy by Montale
description: Hot chocolate with a squeeze of orange and a shot of espresso. Rich, warm, unapologetically sweet. Everyone around you will be able to smell it.

name: Eau Cerise by DSH Perfumes
description: Walking through a farmers market and someone hands you a sample of fresh jam on bread. Natural, slightly earthy, like something picked by hand. Sweet but honest.

name: Eau Duelle by Diptyque
description: A Sunday afternoon nap on the couch. Warm, quiet, slightly sweet. The smell of doing absolutely nothing.

name: Fig & Lotus Flower by Jo Malone London
description: Like coming home after a long trip and your sheets are fresh. Clean, soft, familiar. The moment your body finally unclenches.

name: Geranio Imperiale
description: Sharp enough to notice everything. Soft enough not to point it out.

name: No Comment by Balenciaga
description: Early morning in the countryside before anyone else is awake. Clean cold air, dew on the grass, nothing to check or answer. Just quiet.

name: Rouge by Comme des Garçons
description: A long dinner that started at eight and now it's midnight and nobody wants to leave. Like a spice drawer opened in a warm kitchen. Fills the space around you gently.

name: Vétiver Écarlate by L'Artisan Parfumeur
description: Watering a balcony full of plants in the morning. That green, earthy smell that rises from the soil. A little sharp, a little fresh, earthy and alive.

name: Vetiver Tonka by Hermès
description: Feeling of sinking into the back seat of a warm car after a cold walk. Toasted nuts, warm wood, and a touch of sweetness. Soft, enveloping, comforting. People nearby feel at ease around this scent.
